decision: History is sufficient to document explicit v3->v4->v5->v6 payload evolution, but not to implement speculative v1/v2 migrations. Do not add MinSupportedSchemaVersion or migration switch cases until authoritative v1/v2 semantics or representative fixtures are recovered. Field-history evidence alone does not prove backward-compatibility behavior.

evidence_boundary: AUDIT ONLY. v3-v6 field evolution is history-documented; no claim is made that every older save deserializes safely, that schema 1/2 semantics are known, or that backward compatibility is engine-proven.
